the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Over affine neighbourhoods with u a closed point, the local ring of the scheme-theoretic source fibre at e(u) is Cohen-Macaulay of dimension d_2 by hypothesis. Restricting the groupoid to the point u identifies the local ring of the restricted arrow scheme with the fibre ring modulo both s(m) and t(m), and the chain of restriction and stabilizer dimension lemmas evaluates its dimension as d_1. Since d_1 is smaller, prime avoidance over the finitely many minimal primes of the Cohen-Macaulay fibre ring produces an element f of the maximal ideal whose t-image avoids them all, and the one-equation lemma cuts the fibre dimension below d_2. The quotient A/fA gives the immersion U', non-zerodivisibility of t(f) on the Cohen-Macaulay fibre ring together with the Grothendieck flatness criterion makes h Cohen-Macaulay at (u, e(u)), and the dimension of the cut fibre is d_2 minus one exactly.
